scope: G3 functional branch only: tests of the cold index preparation verifier's refusals, and the first event dispatched over a preparation cut, in a real migrated V2 store; no production caller, produced image, GWIN0 package, installed run or native C activation

branch_policy.owner_decision: On 29 October 2026 the owner kept further sequence-19 G2 testing and GWIN0 completion on feature/g3-gwin0-beta and moved G3 functional development to this branch in the words: complete G3 in a different branch till we fully test G2 and complete GWIN0. This checkpoint is the next step of that work and takes up the two test gaps the preparation checkpoint left open; no separate owner approval of it is claimed

implementation: A test-only entry calls the cold preparation verifier directly with a candidate and location, since no selected C cut can carry a forged candidate to the reader: selecting one would take re-sealed slots, control cells and NV
The preparation test refuses forged candidates, then disturbs the store under the honest cut

The job reconciliation test now carries on past the selection: a preparation over the reconciled selection, a brand-new second owner's first V1 publication over that preparation, a second preparation and damage to the preparation's frame

No production check changed and these tests exposed no production gap. The publisher still has no production caller; production builds do not compile the direct publisher, its cold verifiers, the index effects module or the test-only entry
production_change: None. Commit bd0d65b touches two files, both compiled only under test

refusal_checks.results_format: Each results entry is [result, passed, failed, filtered_out, seconds]

test_behaviour: The honest selected preparation passes the verifier as the control
27 forged candidates are then each refused: 4 forged locations of the honest descriptor and 23 forged descriptors. refusal_cases gives each one's refusal

Forged descriptors are re-sealed, so the event digest and NV continuation are consistent and their location commits their own frame. The exceptions are the absent storage case, which is sealed but has no slot of its own and is presented at the honest location, the unsealed sequence one case, which cannot be sealed, and the job selection descriptor at its own true location
After the forged candidates the NV call count and page inventory are unchanged, and the honest cut still reopens

A torn page in no selection, then an unreviewed directory under attempts, then one flipped byte in sealed member 0 of the tail job that holds the preparation's slot are each refused by the verifier and by the cold reader with the expected text, with no NV dispatch and nothing repaired. They run in this order because an earlier check hides the next, and the last two cannot be undone, so they end the fixture
The job reconciliation test prepares over the reconciled selection, and a cold reopen selects that preparation

A brand-new second owner's first V1 publication is then one NV dispatch over the preparation cut, the first event dispatched over one. A cold reopen selects the V1 with sequence one higher, the previous NV head equal to the preparation's selected head, one more owner root entry and the index generations root unchanged
A second preparation over that V1 is refused with no further NV dispatch, with the text that an unresolved preparation must remain charged
One flipped byte in the preparation's frame then refuses the cold reader with no further NV dispatch, with the text that the sealed tail inode change-time differs
The other three index tests are unchanged and still pass
